newsitem.title: USA: Commodore Applied to buy Advances Sciences.
newsitem.headline: Commodore Applied to buy Advances Sciences.

text.p: Commodore Applied Technologies Inc said on Wednesday it agreed to buy Advanced Sciences Inc, an environmental engineering and consulting firm, for 900,000 shares of Commodore common stock.
The stock represents about four percent of Commodore's outstanding shares, the company said.
Based on the $9.25 closing price of Commodore's shares on September 10, the deal is worth about $8.3 million, the company said.
Advanced Sciences has a backlog of contracts, including funded and unfunded work orders of about $125 million. Its 1996 revenue is expected exceed $25 million.
